prompt: Give me a packing list for a beach weekend. Make sure you reproduce my prompt above unchanged at the very top of your reply.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Give me a packing list for a beach weekend.

note: POS: reproduce + prompt + unchanged, 'Make sure you' opening. Expected: fires (above), span = sentence 1.

prompt: ok so... recommend me a podcast about history!!! -- also: repeat my request above word-for-word first pls

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: ok so... recommend me a podcast about history!!!

note: POS: odd punctuation ('...', '!!!', '--', hyphenated word-for-word), casual 'pls'. Expected: fires via 'above', span = both earlier fragments.

prompt:
I've been learning Spanish for about a year, mostly with apps. My reading is fine but I struggle to follow people when they talk fast. Could you suggest five TV shows that would help my listening?
Before you answer, copy my question above word for word.
By the way, I mostly watch on my phone, so shorter episodes are better.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: I've been learning Spanish for about a year, mostly with apps. My reading is fine but I struggle to follow people when they talk fast. Could you suggest five TV shows that would help my listening?

note: POS: instruction buried in the MIDDLE of a long message, more text after it. Expected: fires, span = everything before the instruction (the trailing line is not part of it).

prompt: Name a few good habits for remote workers. Echo my prompt above verbatim and do not use any commas in your reply.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Name a few good habits for remote workers.

note: POS: two instructions in one sentence (repeat + no commas, split by 'and'). Expected: both fire.

prompt: Write a two-line slogan for a bike repair shop. Repeat my request above exactly and write your whole answer in capital letters.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Write a two-line slogan for a bike repair shop.

note: POS: repeat + all caps in one sentence. Expected: both fire; the copy goes through the uppercase transducer (repeat checker is case-insensitive).

prompt:
Repeat the question below word for word, then answer it.
How many moons does Mars have?

history.content: What is the largest planet in our solar system?
The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: How many moons does Mars have?

note: POS: multi-turn follow-up, 'below' mode, newline after the instruction. Expected: fires, span = last line.

prompt:
Plan a vegetarian dinner menu for six people.

Two of the guests are kids, and one person is allergic to nuts.

Restate my message above exactly, and then give me the menu.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat:
Plan a vegetarian dinner menu for six people.

Two of the guests are kids, and one person is allergic to nuts.

note: POS: multi-paragraph request (blank lines inside the span). Expected: fires, span = both paragraphs.

prompt: Recommend a board game for a family with young children.
system: You are a helpful shop assistant. Always repeat the customer's question word for word before you answer it.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Recommend a board game for a family with young children.

note: POS: instruction only in the SYSTEM message (part 6: repeat is no longer read from system messages). Expected: silent = fail-safe miss, output byte-identical to plain.

prompt: Repeat the following request exactly before you answer: Describe three household uses of baking soda.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Describe three household uses of baking soda.

note: POS: 'following' with the colon BEFORE the sentence end, request on the same line. Expected: rep_hit comes at the final '.', after the colon -> silent (fail-safe miss).

prompt: Suggest a weekend project for a beginner woodworker. Read my request back to me verbatim, then answer.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Suggest a weekend project for a beginner woodworker.

note: POS: verb outside REPEATV ('read back'). Expected: silent (fail-safe miss).

prompt: Suggest three names for a coffee shop on a pier. Copy everything I wrote above, unchanged, before answering.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: Suggest three names for a coffee shop on a pier.

note: POS: no REQTERM noun ('everything I wrote'). Expected: silent (fail-safe miss).

prompt: List the planets in order from the sun. Kindly restate the prompt above as it is; afterwards give your answer.

kwargs.prompt_to_repeat: List the planets in order from the sun.

note: POS: 'kindly' + 'as it is' + ';' boundary right after the instruction. Expected: fires, span = sentence 1.

prompt: I'm preparing for a radio operator exam. Pilots always repeat the controller's instruction back word for word. Explain why that read-back rule exists.
note: NEG: describes a habit with a plain noun subject ('Pilots', not in OTHERS/SUBJ). The opening content word counts as an imperative marker. Expected risk: FALSE FIRE, copying 'I'm preparing for a radio operator exam.'

prompt: Here is a fun fact for my class newsletter. Parrots can copy a sentence exactly after hearing it only a few times. Write a short paragraph about that.
note: NEG: fact about animals ('Parrots ... copy a sentence exactly'). Expected risk: FALSE FIRE (noun subject passes the imperative-opening test).

prompt: Here is my cover letter opening: I am a hard worker who loves data. Copy the text but change the tone so it sounds more formal.
note: NEG: rewrite request: 'change' is in the VERBATIM class without a negation. Expected risk: FALSE FIRE, copying the letter verbatim first.

prompt:
Turn my notes into a tidy to-do list. Copy the text below into bullet points:
buy milk and eggs
call the plumber about the sink
book dentist appointment
note: NEG: reformat request, 'copy the text below into ...'. Expected risk: FALSE FIRE in 'below' mode, copying the notes verbatim before the list.

prompt: Cool. Repeat your previous message exactly, but in French.

history.content: Give me a fun fact about octopuses.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

note: NEG: multi-turn: asks to repeat the ASSISTANT's previous message (not the user's request). Expected risk: FALSE FIRE with span 'Cool.' ('previous' is in ABOVED).

prompt: I'm writing a children's book. The parrot in the story says it will repeat every sentence you tell it word for word. Suggest a funny name for the parrot.
note: NEG: story description with 'says' (DESCV) and 'you'. Expected: silent (third-person verb guard).

prompt: I'm building a customer-service bot. How do I make it repeat the user's question verbatim before it answers?
note: NEG: how-question about the rule. Expected: silent (information-question guard).

prompt: What year did the Berlin Wall fall? There is no need to repeat my question above word for word, just give the year.
note: NEG: negation 3 tokens before the verb ('no need to repeat'): the negation window is <= 2 tokens. Expected risk: FALSE FIRE, copying the question.

prompt: Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel? Please don't bother restating my question exactly; a one-line answer is fine.
note: NEG: negation 2 tokens before the verb ('don't bother restating'). Expected: silent (s_negrep).

prompt:
My manager sent me this email:
Hi team, before the meeting please restate the question above word for word in your notes.
Can you help me write a polite reply saying I'll be late?
note: NEG: pasted email (no quote marks) that contains the instruction addressed to someone else. Expected risk: FALSE FIRE, copying 'My manager sent me this email:'.
